Nospoon 0.5.2 updates the C++ client and server to HyperDHT 0.6.0, bringing the recent connection, reconnect, shutdown and error-reporting improvements. The VPN configuration and wire format stay the same.

Linux downloads are fully static single binaries for x86-64 and ARM64. The Windows archive contains `nospoon.exe` and `wintun.dll`, with no Visual C++ Redistributable required. Use the `-release` download for normal use; `-debug` builds log peer addresses and other connection details.

Build dependencies match HyperDHT: libuv 1.51.0, libsodium 1.0.22 and libudx `759bf764`. macOS remains available from source. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
